name: How long does it take to complete a tiny home bathroom upgrade?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to complete a tiny home bathroom upgrade?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a tiny home bathroom upgrade can vary depending on the scope of work. A minor upgrade, such as replacing fixtures or retiling, might take 1-2 weeks. A more extensive renovation involving reconfiguring the layout, installing new plumbing, or adding features like a larger shower or composting toilet could take 3-5 weeks. Factors like material availability, the complexity of custom elements, and the need for inspections can influence the overall duration. We provide a detailed project schedule after an initial consultation and design finalization.
acceptedAnswer.description: A tiny home bathroom upgrade can take 1-2 weeks for minor changes or 3-5 weeks for extensive renovations, depending on the scope and complexity of the work involved.
